sql:
WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS avg_val
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT `School Name`, `District Type`
FROM frpm
WHERE `Charter Funding Type` = 'Locally funded'
  AND (`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > avg_val.avg_val
ORDER BY `School Name`;

FROM account a

FROM loan

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c1 ON s.eye_colour_id = c1.id
JOIN colour c2 ON s.hair_colour_id = c2.id
WHERE c1.colour = 'Blue' AND c2.colour = 'Blond';

sql:

FROM superhero 
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id 
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id 
WHERE colour.colour = 'Gold' AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

sql:

FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

sql:
SELECT r.year
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Brands Hatch' AND r.name = 'British Grand Prix'
ORDER BY r.year DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql:
SELECT r.name, rs.points
FROM races r
JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ds.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN results rs ON r.raceId = rs.raceId AND ds.driverId = rs.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year, r.round
LIMIT 1;
label: ok

WHERE r.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND dr.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND dr.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT (SUM(e.cost) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.link_to_budget)) AS percentage
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.type = 'Meeting';

JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312';
